selectionReason: Nov 6 weekly AI drawdown and Nov 9 neutral positioning downgrade favor valuation-versus-earnings discipline and explicit downside evidence; rotated away from Nov 8 lessons HL002 and HL020. Sources: Reuters Nov 6 and Nov 9, 2026.

cards.title: Watch the gap between promise and profits
cards.question: What if AI revenue grows but expected returns do not?
cards.selfCheck: HL024: Compare priced-in growth with cash flow and actual deployment. A valuation reset is not proof of demand collapse; weaker realized profits would be disconfirming.
cards.prompt: Explain handwritten lesson HL024 with the Nov 2026 AI capex-versus-cash-flow debate and a falsifiable example.

cards.title: Use both good and bad evidence
cards.question: What evidence would make you abandon the AI supplier thesis?
cards.selfCheck: HL015: Track strong orders AND cancellations, financing, dilution and estimate cuts. Friday's rebound alone cannot settle the question.
cards.prompt: Explain handwritten lesson HL015 using November 2026 semiconductor correction; give a two-sided evidence checklist.
